conventions.bbox: [x0, y0, x1, y1], fractions of the PDF page (A4, incl. the white frame around the scan)

drawings.description: à droite de la page, un croquis à l'encre : deux axes portés $\beta$ et $\alpha$, et une courbe qui découpe la région des indices
drawings.kind: two axes beta, alpha and a curve cutting the region of indices
drawings.notes: Ink: a vertical axis beta and a horizontal axis alpha, a short oblique stroke at the origin, and a rising curve cutting the quadrant; two faint pencil strokes inside. A second "beta" lower on the vertical axis is drawn as on the page. The large pencil strokes of the sheet that cross it (other sketches) are left out.

drawings.description: croquis en marge de gauche : un trait oblique « $D_{o} = X_{o}$ » coupé par deux traits courts épais, « $D_{1}$ » en haut et « $D_{2}$ » en bas ; entre les deux, sur $D_{o}$, une marque épaisse (une petite flèche pointant vers la gauche) et la lettre « $\bar{\xi}_{o}$ ».
drawings.kind: a divisor D_0 = X_0 cut by D_1 and D_2, with the point xi_0
drawings.notes: The oblique line D_0 = X_0, the two short heavy strokes that cross it (D_1 above, D_2 below), each drawn through a point computed on D_0, the labels where he wrote them, and between the two crossings the point marked on D_0 with the short heavy stroke that ends on it from the right (on the page a small arrow pointing left, towards the line) and the label xi-bar_0. Left out: a faint pencil circle round the marked point and a faint arc at the foot of the crop. Still differs: the heavy mark between the crossings is drawn as a point with a short arrow; on the page it is a blotted arrowhead. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au milieu de la page, à gauche, un croquis en perspective au crayon : trois diviseurs $D_{0}$, $D_{1}$, $D_{2}$ se coupant à croisements normaux, figurés par trois plans --- un plan frontal (marqué $D_{2}$ en bas à gauche), divisé en quatre par une verticale et une horizontale, d'où partent trois obliques vers un plan vertical à droite (marqué $D_{1}$), et un plan intermédiaire marqué $D_{0}$.
drawings.kind: three planes meeting with normal crossings (perspective sketch)
drawings.notes: Pencil sketch, redrawn stroke by stroke: the front rectangle (left side, bottom in two strokes, right side, curved top) with its vertical and its horizontal middle lines; three oblique strokes rising to the right from the top, the middle and the foot of the vertical middle line; the heavy vertical stroke at the right; a faint curved stroke from the left side up to the upper left; a faint wavy stroke under the label D_0; the short faint stroke that joins the upper oblique to the top of the right vertical. Labels D_0 (upper middle), D_1 (upper right), D_2 (lower left). Still differs: it is a free perspective sketch; which stroke bounds which plane is not settled, and the strokes are drawn as they are, without being completed into three planes. The note of the transcription describes three planes whose lines of intersection meet in one point: the redraw neither confirms nor contradicts it. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en haut de la page, un dessin : deux branches, $X_{T'}$ horizontale et $X_{T''}$ verticale, se coupant en un point ; de part et d'autre du point, chaque branche est doublée d'un faisceau de deux traits qui s'évasent en s'éloignant, hachuré de petits traits transverses ; autour du point de croisement, un disque semé de points porte la lettre $Z$.
drawings.kind: two branches X_T' and X_T'' crossing at a point, with a dotted disc Z
drawings.notes: The horizontal line X_T' and the vertical line X_T'' through one crossing point; on each of the four half-branches a wedge of two strokes opening away from the crossing point (drawn from that point), hatched with short transverse strokes (three on the left, four on the right, five above, four below, as counted on the page; each computed between the two strokes of its wedge); the disc round the crossing point, strewn with about fifteen dots, and the letter Z in its upper right part; the labels X_T'' (top) and X_T' (right). Still differs: the wedge strokes are slightly curved on the page (the vertical ones clearly so) and are drawn straight; the dots are placed roughly; the lower part of the vertical line is heavy on the page. The note of the transcription says « un petit disque pointillé »: the outline is a full line, the dots are inside. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en haut à gauche de la feuille, un arbre orienté : d'une racine à gauche part une arête vers un premier sommet, qui se ramifie vers la droite en deux branches, elles-mêmes ramifiées ; toutes les arêtes sont fléchées en s'éloignant de la racine, les sommets marqués de points.
drawings.kind: rooted tree with arrows away from the root
drawings.notes: As on the page: the root at the left, one edge to the first vertex, which branches into an upper and a lower branch; the upper branch divides again (a heavy branch going up to the right, which forks at its end, and a branch to the right, which forks twice); the lower branch runs to the right through two vertices and forks at the second. Eighteen edges, each drawn as an arrow between its two vertices, pointing away from the root; the vertices are marked with points (leaves are arrow tips). This figure is not mentioned in the notes of the transcription. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite de « $S \leftarrow S'$ », une esquisse simpliciale : un triangle de sommet $a$ en bas, dont les trois côtés sont fléchés et marqués $d_1$ (à gauche), $d_2$ (en haut) et $d_0$ (à droite), l'intérieur hachuré ; un faisceau de longues flèches le relie à un point $x$ en bas à gauche.
drawings.kind: simplicial sketch: a triangle with faces d_0, d_1, d_2 and arrows from a point x
drawings.notes: The triangle: the side from a up to the upper left vertex (arrow, marked d_1), the top side as an arrow pointing left towards that vertex (marked d_2), the side from a up to the right vertex (arrow, marked d_0), drawn between the same three vertices, with a few hatching strokes inside; the point a with its letter; the point x at the lower left with its letter; and the bundle of long arrows between x and the triangle: two from x up to the middle of the sheet (heads at the top), one coming down to x from the same place, two from the right vertex down to x, and a double one from x to a. Left out: the long thin line that crosses the sheet obliquely (a separator), a blotted letter above the upper left vertex and a letter above the right vertex (b, uncertain), other sketches of the sheet that enter the crop. Still differs: the arrows of the bundle overlap and their number and direction are a reading; the hatching is free. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en bas à gauche, un petit croquis --- deux ouverts $U$ et $V$ se coupant, avec « $x_1, x_2 \in U$ » --- qui n'est pas repris ici
drawings.kind: two intersecting open sets U and V
drawings.notes: Two quadrilaterals overlapping: U (thin) and V (heavy), a point in their intersection, labels U, V and "x_1, x_2 in U". The transcription does not reproduce it; redrawn here.
